notes: Two taḥwīl branches. The text names a Mazini man in each, unnamed; the one shared name written once after the last «ح» is Abu Hurayra, so he is the shared tail
«ونحن عند سعيد بن المسيب» is the place where the Mazini man spoke: not a link (rule 6)
«- ثم اتفقا -» and «- وهذا حديث معمر وهو أتم -» are glosses, left out
